violation_type.title: Toilets, Sinks and Fountains Used Safely and Independently (26 TAC §746.4419)
violation_type.short_title: Toilets, Sinks and Fountains Used Safely and Independently
violation_type.typical_finding: A chair is used by children to climb and drink water from drinking fountain.     CORRECTED at inspection when an age approprtiate step stool was placed for children to use.

finding_variants.text: A chair is used by children to climb and drink water from drinking fountain.     CORRECTED at inspection when an age approprtiate step stool was placed for children to use.
2 classrooms for young children were missing non-slip steps for children to reach the adult sized hand washing sinks.

Children's restrooms were not equipped with step stools to allow children to use the sinks and toilets safely and independently.      Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as step stools were provided in each restroom.

I did not observe a step stool in one preschool classroom to allow smaller children to easily reach the hand washing sink.  This was corrected at the time of the inspection when a step stool was placed in the restroom.
The children's bathroom is not equipped with anchored steps and/or a broad- based platform with a non-slip surface.
